issue: The pinned Linode label pattern uses unescaped .. in the negative lookahead, rejecting the provider's linode123 example; the current provider contract escapes the dots as \.\..

The pinned response schema marks Linode host_uuid as RFC UUID format, while the provider documents a non-RFC host machine identifier and its published response example uses 1a2bcd34e5f67gh8ij901234567kl89mn01opqr2. The node preserves this string.

The pinned schema marks created, updated and backups.last_successful as RFC date-time, but the provider documents timezone-less timestamps such as 2026-01-01T00:01:01 and 2026-01-02T00:01:01. The node preserves the documented strings.
